verified_boundaries.finding: Candidate protocol, preparation, recovery, broadcast and handoff modules are all cfg(test). Do not promote them or the new adapter to runtime routes.
Current backend describes only legacy and DPCLK2. DPCLK3 remains separate; candidate guest uses clock proofVersion 2, so domain must not be inferred from clock version.

Pinned candidate program and independently trusted request must match before callback; native output plus full-container registration input hash and ordered body evidence are independently computed. The existing response validator checks program/public bytes/bounded nonempty opaque proof, not cryptographic proof authenticity.
Material hash binds exact ordered full containers/refs/evidence under policy. It does not authenticate DON signatures or prove original archive IDs after extraction.
PreparationTransport has no broadcast method; canonical stored-cut semantics checked independently. Pending stage is persisted before registration and Resume must not retransmit.

Fixed physical source lane plus source-first/B-second cooperative leases already spans callbacks and return; adapter must use this existing coordinator rather than create a second retry or durability mechanism.

wire_recommendation.constructor: FixtureTransport::new(endpoint:SocketAddr, request:&ProtocolRequest, trusted:&TrustedRequest, bridge:&BridgeTarget, sender:[u8;20], nonce:u64) pure validation, zero socket work
wire_recommendation.endpoint: Literal IPv4 127.0.0.1 and nonzero caller-owned ephemeral port only; no URLs/DNS/proxy/curl/credentials/env reads/redirects
wire_recommendation.domain: New explicit fixture-only wire magic/schema and operation routes, never /prove or the existing service identity schema
wire_recommendation.decode: Bound HTTP headers/body first; fixed-width framing length before allocation; canonical postcard of bounded newly defined DTOs; reject trailing data and unknown variants. Existing non-Serde Lookup<T> maps via new wire DTOs without old source edits. Byte fields use bounded visitor before allocation, not only postdecode length checks.
wire_recommendation.retry_policy: One connection/exchange per callback. Any socket/status/partial/truncated/deadline/echo error returns one callback error. No automatic retries for registration, proof or broadcast. Coordinator Resume performs only allowed lookup sequence.

reusable_corpus.expected: Both phase0 flows retain seven native roots, count=9 and nonzero prefix tip; pinned public32 commitment remains unchanged.
